tasks.title: Read a simple service notice
tasks.objective: Read opening hours, choose a compatible slot and confirm the day, time and place in a short exchange.
tasks.context:
Accueil de l’université : ouvert du lundi au vendredi, de neuf heures à midi. Le mardi après-midi, accueil sur rendez-vous seulement. Pour demander un rendez-vous, indiquez votre disponibilité. N’envoyez pas de document personnel dans cet exercice.

Understand: Du lundi au vendredi gives the range of days. De neuf heures à midi gives morning hours. Sur rendez-vous means by appointment: it does not say that every afternoon is open. Indiquez is a polite instruction. Use invented details only.

tasks.title: Confirm the arrangement
tasks.objective: Read opening hours, choose a compatible slot and confirm the day, time and place in a short exchange.
tasks.context:
— Bonjour. Je suis disponible mardi à quatorze heures. Est-ce possible ?
— Oui. Le rendez-vous est mardi à quatorze heures, au bureau trois.
— Très bien. Mardi, à quatorze heures, au bureau trois. Merci !

Understand: Disponible states availability. Est-ce possible ? checks a proposal. Repeat the day, time and place to confirm. À quatorze heures is at 14:00. Au bureau combines à + le. The notice permits Tuesday afternoon appointments, so this exchange is consistent with it.

tasks.objective: Read opening hours, choose a compatible slot and confirm the day, time and place in a short exchange.
tasks.context:
Write 45–65 French words: request a routine university appointment compatible with the notice, state one availability and ask for confirmation. Then write the reply with the same day, time and office. Use invented details only. Read both roles aloud and ask the Tutor to change one detail so that you can confirm it.

Review criteria: Check all three details against the notice; check day/time consistency, à/au and a polite greeting/closing. Tomorrow retrieve the details without looking, then practise a different available slot.
